title: Mid-senior B2B SaaS product manager
description: A 6-year B2B SaaS product manager (roadmaps, discovery, working SQL) evaluated against 8 postings: a strong PM match with PLG gaps, a second solid PM role, a keyword-stuffed project-coordinator trap, a marginal product-marketing role, and four distractors.
rationale: The resume is a non-engineering profile — a 6-year B2B SaaS product manager — testing that the matcher works outside software-engineering vocabulary. j3 is the keyword trap: a PMO project-coordinator posting stuffed with 'product roadmap', 'backlog', 'sprint', and 'stakeholder' tokens, but every duty is administrative (scheduling ceremonies, taking minutes, formatting slide decks), so it is grade 0 despite heavy lexical overlap with the resume. j4 (product marketing) probes the graded boundary: real overlap on customer interviews and B2B SaaS context, but a different job family, hence grade 1. Gap target j1 is a strong PM match whose product-led growth strategy and usage-based pricing demands are genuine gaps, while roadmapping, discovery, SQL, and stakeholder management are must_not_claim skills the resume plainly holds.

resume.summary: Product manager with 6 years in B2B SaaS, from associate-level discovery work to owning a multi-squad product line. Strong in continuous customer discovery, roadmap prioritization, and experiment-driven delivery, with working SQL for self-serve product analytics.

jobs.raw_text:
Senior Product Manager, Growth — Ledgerline (Remote, US)

Ledgerline sells usage-based billing infrastructure to B2B SaaS companies, and we are moving from sales-led to product-led growth. You will own the roadmap for our self-serve onboarding and activation funnel, run continuous discovery interviews with finance teams, design and analyze experiments across pricing and onboarding, and align engineering, design, and sales stakeholders around quarterly OKRs.

Requirements: product roadmapping, customer discovery, SQL, product-led growth (PLG) strategy, and stakeholder management. 5+ years of product management in B2B SaaS, a track record of experiments that moved activation or revenue metrics, and hands-on experience with usage-based pricing and billing models. Bachelor's degree in business, economics, or a related field.

Nice to have: Python for data analysis, SOC 2 / enterprise compliance familiarity, Amplitude or Mixpanel.

Product Manager, Core Platform — Wrenly (Hybrid, Minneapolis MN)

Wrenly builds workflow automation software for operations teams at mid-market companies. Our workflow builder is used by 1,200 B2B customers and needs a dedicated product owner.

You will own the workflow builder roadmap, run discovery interviews with operations leaders, write PRDs, and drive delivery with two squads on an agile cadence. You will use SQL and product analytics to decide what to build next and to measure what shipped.

Requirements: product roadmapping, customer discovery and user interviews, PRD writing, agile delivery, and SQL for product analytics. 4+ years of product management in B2B SaaS. Nice to have: Amplitude or Mixpanel, Figma for wireframing.

Project Coordinator, PMO — Consolidated Facilities Group (Onsite, Columbus OH)

Consolidated Facilities Group manages janitorial and maintenance contracts for commercial buildings. Our PMO needs a Project Coordinator who keeps the product roadmap deck, backlog spreadsheets, and stakeholder calendars in perfect order.

You will schedule sprint ceremonies and stakeholder meetings across five project teams, keep the product roadmap slides and backlog trackers formatted and current, record meeting minutes, chase action-item status updates, and book rooms and travel for quarterly planning sessions.

Requirements: calendar management, meeting minutes, Jira board administration, status report formatting, Microsoft Office. 1+ years in project coordination or administrative support. Bonus: prior PMO or executive-assistant experience.
